tool_args.rationale: The offered trajectory batch addresses a genuine identifiability gap in the verified five-parameter coupled ODE before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows are insufficient to reliably identify the five coupled parameters; the verified mechanism calls for at least eight rows.
Neither is offered in the probe menu, and the pilot does not indicate narrow-gradient collinearity or a supercritical gradient.
These present-snapshot models do not account for the observed coupled transient lag and memory-conditioned readout.
It is irrelevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
